description.ja: • ピカちんロボSはキットに合体して機能を拡張できる新シリーズだ！
description.en: • Pikachin Robo S is a new series that can be combined with Kit to expand its functions!

description.ja: • 左右の耳を入れ替えられるギミックを搭載！
description.en: • Equipped with a gimmick that allows you to swap left and right ears!

description.ja: • ボディが回転！６面すべて柄が違う！
description.en: • The body rotates! All 6 sides have different patterns!

description.ja: • 「ピカちんキットS02 ウソ発見器」（別売）と合体！どんなウソをついているかルーレットが教える！
description.en: • Combined with "Pikachin KitS02 Lie Detector" (sold separately)! Roulette will tell you what kind of lie you are telling!
